# about the pack
, choose to spawn as the Sniper, twirl around the planes and execute your targets with martial violence

, heavily based on REDLINER on roblox; if you enjoy head on combat, parrying, movement and guns, you might enjoy it
[[REDLINER]](https://www.roblox.com/games/94987506187454/REDLINER)


, dont forget to download the resourcepack
